results.fact: Approach line to The Fin (Needle Pass ridge traverse vs Sawtooth Pass slope)
results.correct_value: Leave the Gladys Divide trail near 4,400 ft (about a mile past Flapjack Lakes) and climb southeast to Sawtooth Pass, the chute beside The Fin; the NE face starts just east of the pass. Needle Pass serves the spires north of The Fin.

results.evidence: Outside sources give only whole-trip figures: ~17 mi round trip and 5,500 ft gain, which the itinerary (7.5+2+7.5 mi; 3,050+2,450 ft) already matches. The waypoint distMi values (Fin at 10.5) trace the off-route Gladys Divide/Needle Pass line and are unsourced; no source states the camp-to-summit distance, gain or The Fin's summit elevation (the area page lists 5,263 ft, the row 5,599 ft), so nothing is changed.

No source gives an NCCS commitment grade for The Fin. The 'IV' appears to come from the route page's grade conversion table, where 5.4 is listed as 'IV UIAA' — a difficulty conversion, not a commitment grade — so the stored 'IV' is very likely wrong, but no two sources state the correct numeral.
